claim_boundary: one look at the sealed #109 evaluation split; LC (#112 v3) recipe only; prediction-error DP labels (lambda 1e-4) only; grid primary; tie-free cost; DESCRIPTIVE intervals; NovPhy only; sub-frame Delta unsupported

decision_rule.disposition_dp: 'the DP labeller stays tractable at |R| = 225': supported iff every usable R_cont predictor's exact round-0 prediction-error DP over the #109 policy pool (N = 3480 start-0 windows, L = 225 frames, chunk 256) completes on one RTX 5090 within 3600 GPU s and its seconds per carrier evaluation are at most 2 x the R_9 mean (no super-linear growth in |R|); not_supported_by_this_experiment iff any R_cont pass fails either; readiness_or_precision_insufficient if no R_cont predictor is usable
decision_rule.disposition_ranking: 'a larger or continuous Delta set improves ranking over R_9': per set R in {R_18, R_30, R_cont} and budget b in {total, request}, the grid tie-free AUC of the flat-head policy J-flat(R, b) minus J-flat(R_9), paired by (level, seed), level-clustered bootstrap; delta superiority token (mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0 supported; upper < 0.02 not_supported_by_this_experiment; else readiness_or_precision_insufficient). Overall: supported iff some set is supported under both budgets; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff every (set, budget) token is not_supported_by_this_experiment; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.guard_failure: a failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.pairing: cells (level, seed): seed s of every configuration pairs with Gate-B seed s; a typed-failure member drops its seed's cells from every contrast that reads it; the bootstrap resamples levels
decision_rule.secondary: DESCRIPTIVE with the same delta token reported: heads (J-factorised / J-ordinal - J-flat per set), the fixed R_9-request mean of each set - R_9, J-flat - prior, right - wrong anchor; offset, angle and power; rollout error, label accuracy, MACs, Delta histograms, DP cost

sub_frame_delta.reason: one carrier frame is 50 native engine steps (the #104 / #109 capture stride, frames 30000 + 50 i); a Delta below one frame has no observed target in any existing capture, and a finer-stride capture is outside the frozen #109 / #104 plan (an owner decision, not this ticket)

disclosure: Known before the freeze: Gate B (unit 0.7444, C* 0.7834, prior 0.7203 on grid); #101 (J 0.706, fixed F-15-continuous 0.762, F-15-macro 0.744 on grid); #117 (full-budget Delta = 5 / 15 specialists rank above the joint by 0.05-0.14; Delta = 1 joint rows barely use the anchor). No predictor or policy over a set other than R_9 existed, and no #109 policy trained on 225-frame labels. The smoke rescored only published models on the evaluation cells (Gate-B unit, #101 fixed requests and J, #115 F-15-micro) to reproduce their records. Hardware: RTX 5090 instead of the #85 RTX 3090.

dp_labels.kind: prediction error (ICLR eq. dp; #101 pe): c(t, i) = Delta_i x one-step carrier MSE + lambda x work(pair_i, flat policy of R) / work(15, continuous)
dp_labels.mac_term: the set's flat policy (width 128) for every head, so round-0 labels depend on (predictor, R) only
dp_labels.pool: the #109 policy split as built by #101 (3480 shots, 120 levels, E99 carriers)

pruned.rule: round-half-up of 12 geometric points from 1 to 75; candidate requests = grid x alpha; R_cont only; disagreement with the exact labels on every labelled position

dp_labels.timing_pass: exact round-0 labels on the first 60 frames (cost only)
dp_labels.window: start-0 windows of 225 frames (rp.first_window rule, terminal absorption), the deployment horizon, so every Delta <= 75 is feasible

evaluation.arms: per configuration and seed: every fixed request of R (endpoint rule) and every head's greedy policy J (joint argmax); the wrong-anchor control of J-flat (16 grid candidates from the 480 fit anchors)
evaluation.cost: tie_free (EndpointCosts.row against the anchor); cell AUC m99.view
evaluation.label_accuracy: exact DP labels of the head's predictor on every grid evaluation branch (E99 parses 0..min(225, last) from the #115 store, observed contexts, remaining = frames to the window end); share of positions whose greedy request equals the label (exact, Delta, alpha); branch mean, level mean over seeds, level bootstrap
evaluation.macs: linear MACs per candidate rollout (predictor + policy), policy MACs per call, Delta histograms
evaluation.rollout_error: #100 engine_position_mse of every mixed grid candidate's endpoint (t = 225) against its own branch at min(225, last frame), the #115 engine-truth store (hash-bound)
evaluation.split: the #109 evaluation split as in Gate B (stream issue109-evaluation, mixed cells)

execution.rule: each stage launched once (one process per GPU, worker PIDs recorded under logs/), then waited on; no relaunch over live workers; a crashed worker resumes its own assignment (training resumes from its progress checkpoint)

generalisation.predictor: request_sets.predictor_class(R): CNNHybridPredictor whose carrier accepts exactly R; same parameters (1 837 690), state dict and ops; PairConditioner encodes any integer Delta
generalisation.replication_guard: smoke: R_9 training equals the retrain train_group bit for bit (schedule and full cost, 12 updates); the R_9 fixed-request rows equal the Gate-B unit and #101 records; the #101 J reproduces through the generalised rollout; the DP labels equal request_policy.window_rows in both DAgger rounds; G5 re-checks every R_9 fixed row

guards.G1_isolation: fit payload members, policy-pool levels and evaluation levels are disjoint; wrong anchors are fit levels
guards.G2_scoring_policy: every record and every label report carries the #111 SCORING_POLICY
guards.G3_chronology: frozen_at <= every training; every training and labelling <= the first score
guards.G4_binding: predictor hashes = training records (R_9: handoff); policy hashes = label reports; training payload, policy-pool windows and truth store = the frozen hashes
guards.G5_replication: every R_9 fixed-request row equals the Gate-B unit / #101 records (all seeds and inventories)
guards.G6_training_integrity: every member's schedule is its frozen schedule and every update is logged
guards.failure: a failed guard turns every token into readiness_or_precision_insufficient

definitions.factorised: trunk -> Delta head x alpha head; joint log-probabilities
definitions.ordinal: trunk -> cumulative-logit Delta head (one score, ordered thresholds) x alpha head

policies.matching: factorised / ordinal hidden width chosen so the parameter count is closest to the set's flat head
policies.recipe: #101 pe: torch.manual_seed(seed + 7700) init; round 0 on observed-context labels; round 1 on the head's own DAgger contexts; rp.distil_round (2 x 1800 steps, batch 128, AdamW 1e-3, unit = policy level); cross-entropy on the joint scores (sum of factor NLLs for factorised / ordinal)
policies.seed_pairing: policy seed s uses predictor seed s

prohibited: reading evaluation captures for training or selection
changing a set, budget, head, rule or recipe after the freeze
retrying or replacing a typed failure
question: what happens to rollout error, ranking, DP labelling cost and policy accuracy when the request set grows beyond R_9 = {1, 5, 15} x alpha, up to an effectively continuous Delta?
records: records, label files, update logs and checkpoints stay local; records-manifest.json (sha256 of every record, label report, round-0 label file and update log) is committed
role: #116 Work 1-6 in full, including the ranking comparison across request sets, confirmatory on the #104 sealed #109 evaluation split after Gate B passed

smoke_evidence.reading: infrastructure assertions only; nothing kept; no statistic of a new model output; the only evaluation rows computed reproduce published Gate-B, #101 and #115 records

budgets.R_9: both budgets are the Gate-B joint (9000 updates, 1000 per request): not retrained
budgets.request: 1000 x |R| updates (1000 per request, the Gate-B joint's per-request count)
budgets.total: 9000 updates (the Gate-B count): 9000 / |R| updates per request

training.curriculum_clock: update u of an n-update run reads the horizon curriculum and the ranking ramp at u * 9000 // n (identity at 9000 updates)

data.definition: the retrain's #109 fit payload (13 919 shots, 680 ranking cells)

training.endpoint_rule: fixed requests (ranking term in training and every fixed-request scoring rollout): floor(225 / Delta) transitions of the request, then the #101 same-alpha fallback (the largest Delta' in R with Delta' <= remaining) until exactly 225; Delta | 225 is the fixed request itself. Policies mask Delta > remaining
training.local_window: an update of Delta reads a window of max(60, 4 Delta) transitions at the drawn window start (same index draw), so every Delta keeps four local transitions where the shot allows; Delta <= 15 is the payload window
training.long_horizon: floor(horizon / Delta) transitions of the trained pair; none when Delta > horizon
training.recipe: #112 v3 LC (the Gate-B recipe): #77 local loss, long-horizon recursion to the curriculum horizon, decision-contrastive ranking, truncation every 45 transitions, skip-on-nonfinite ensemble (patience 10); fold 'all', one member per (configuration, seed), seeds [20260908, 20260909, 20260910]

long.targets: the E99 parsed carrier at every visited position start + j * delta, terminal absorption past the shot's last frame

rank.cost: tie_free (scoring_harness.tie_free on tensors): pig presence - 0.1 x pig-slot center displacement between the anchor carrier and the rollout endpoint at 225

training.schedule: round robin over R in declared order (R_9: PAIRS[step % 9], the retrain schedule)
training.usable: complete, at most 45 skipped updates per 9000 (scaled to the member's updates), every update logged, no #117 end-of-training excursion (rt.excursion over its own schedule); an unusable member is a typed terminal failure, never retried or replaced, and gets no policy
